truth_boundary: Public-repository evidence only. This is not a certification, legal opinion, security guarantee or government approval.

controls.title: System purpose and intended users are defined
controls.why: Dedicated purpose evidence satisfied the deterministic source-evidence rule.
controls.evidence: Repository evidence pinned to immutable commit revision.
controls.next: No remediation required; keep evidence fresh.

controls.title: AI provider/deployer role and risk classification is reviewed
controls.why: Repository documents cannot authorise an organisational/legal conclusion.
controls.evidence: Candidate role/risk language observed in repository.
controls.next: Named accountable reviewer signs an authenticated role/risk attestation.

controls.title: Named accountable control owners exist
controls.why: An unauthenticated Markdown owner list cannot satisfy an E4 control.
controls.next: Capture authenticated attestations for named control owners.

controls.title: Model/provider inventory is current
controls.why: Model/provider references exist but no dedicated current inventory satisfies the promotion rule.
controls.evidence: Provider/model mentions detected across repository files.
controls.next: Create a machine-readable model/provider inventory with purpose, version, environment, owner and review date; re-scan.

controls.title: Human authority boundary is explicit and implemented
controls.why: Static source can describe approval gates but cannot prove deployed enforcement.
controls.evidence: Human approval / authority language observed in source.
controls.next: Run an environment-bound approval-bypass test and preserve result, timestamp, environment and evidence hash.

controls.title: User-facing AI transparency/disclosure is implemented where applicable
controls.why: The relevant deployed user journey was not observed by the repository scan.
controls.next: Observe the deployed journey and capture explicit AI disclosure evidence.

controls.title: Known limitations and prohibited/non-goal uses are documented
controls.why: Dedicated limitations evidence satisfied the deterministic rule.
controls.next: Keep it current and tie changes to release review.

controls.title: End-to-end data flow is documented
controls.why: Architecture references exist, but not a dedicated end-to-end data-flow artifact.
controls.next: Create DATA_FLOW.md or structured equivalent covering inputs, storage, model/provider calls, outputs, logging, retention and deletion.

controls.title: Processors/subprocessors are inventoried
controls.why: Vendor mentions are not a current processor inventory.
controls.next: Create a current processor/subprocessor inventory with purpose, data categories, region, DPA/status and review date.

controls.title: Retention and deletion behavior is defined and technically evidenced
controls.why: Policy/source statements cannot prove deployed deletion behavior.
controls.next: Run an environment-bound retention/deletion verification and preserve proof.

controls.title: Authentication, authorization and tenant boundaries are technically evidenced
controls.why: Source code is not independent proof of deployed tenant isolation.
controls.next: Run a cross-tenant/authz probe in the exact deployed environment.

controls.title: Security contact and vulnerability intake process exist
controls.why: Security language exists but no dedicated intake artifact satisfied the rule.
controls.next: Add SECURITY.md with a concrete vulnerability reporting/intake process and re-scan.

controls.title: Security/AI incident response is defined and exercised
controls.why: A plan cannot prove the process was exercised.
controls.next: Run and record a tabletop or technical incident exercise with dated outcomes and owners.

controls.title: Audit trace exists for consequential AI/tool actions
controls.why: Static implementation cannot prove production audit events exist and are replayable.
controls.next: Capture a real consequential action, its approval event, immutable audit record and replay/trace proof.

controls.title: Evaluations cover important failure modes and limitations
controls.why: Concrete tests/evals and CI satisfy the technical evidence rule.
controls.evidence: Repository test/eval artifacts tied to immutable revision.
controls.next: Expand benchmark with every real failure and keep CI gating.

controls.title: Production monitoring and regression detection exist
controls.why: Repository config cannot prove monitoring is active in production.
controls.next: Capture an environment-bound monitoring observation and a synthetic regression/alert proof.

controls.title: Backup/restore and rollback capability is evidenced where state is durable
controls.why: A runbook cannot prove restore/rollback was exercised.
controls.next: Run a restore or rollback drill and preserve the evidence.

controls.title: Software/model supply chain inventory and change provenance exist
controls.why: Accepted dependency/change provenance evidence exists.
controls.evidence: Repository dependency/change provenance tied to immutable revision.
controls.next: Keep provenance current and add model-provider change tracking.

controls.title: Buyer-facing assurance pack cites evidence and unknowns
controls.why: Trust-oriented documentation exists but does not yet satisfy buyer-pack evidence/unknown requirements.
controls.next: Generate a buyer pack that cites each accepted evidence item and explicitly lists unknowns/unresolved controls.

controls.title: Evidence has freshness/expiry metadata
controls.why: Evidence exists without a complete machine-readable freshness/expiry contract.
controls.evidence: Provenance exists but buyer-facing freshness manifest is incomplete.
controls.next: Create an evidence manifest with observed_at, valid_until, hashes, source revision and rule version.
